headline: Anthropic IPO faces potential delay or discount amid ongoing tech sector selloff
summary: The ongoing technology selloff raises questions about whether Anthropic will delay its initial public offering or list at a discounted valuation.
why: Initial public offerings of major artificial intelligence developers serve as key market barometers for venture capital liquidity and investor appetite in high-growth technology sectors.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Anthropic is the company preparing for the potential initial public offering mentioned in the report.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broader selloff in technology stocks reduces market valuations and investor demand, complicating plans for upcoming high-profile initial public offerings.
